## Result and scope

For the adopted nine-species, two-reaction, two-liquid extraction case,
requesting three independent exact first responses in one batch reduced median
wall time from **4.045 ms to 2.076 ms (48.7%)** on the same installed Engine wheel.
The batch reuses the central state and its linear factorization; it does not
replace the single IPOPT equilibrium driver or accelerate the initial solve.
This is current-main integration evidence for [issue #104](https://github.com/tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT/issues/104),
not an external-package comparison or a demonstrated flowsheet speedup.

![Three independent first-response directions on the same wheel. Colored points show all five measurements; black crosses and whiskers show the median and inclusive p10–p90. Both workloads include one problem compilation and exclude the already completed central solve.](figures/first-response-runtime.png){#fig-response-runtime}

| Workload | Wall median (ms) | Wall p10–p90 (ms) | CPU median (ms) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Three separate exact first-response requests | 4.045 | 3.837–4.210 | 4.045 |
| One batch of three exact first responses | 2.076 | 2.040–2.358 | 2.077 |
| Three central finite differences (six equilibrium solves) | 786.728 | 753.039–836.817 | 786.476 |
| Equilibrium from declared guesses, warmed model tapes | 142.662 | 138.782–143.688 | 142.656 |
| Equilibrium with initially empty model tapes | 142.507 | 140.993–152.294 | 142.498 |
| Equilibrium from the previous converged state | 114.637 | 113.360–138.425 | 114.640 |

Each workload has one discarded warmup and five retained samples with alternating
execution order. Model construction and import are excluded from all timed rows;
the empty-tape row includes first recordings. The first solve after initial model
construction took 138.448 ms. These few samples support a local timing comparison,
not a machine-independent latency guarantee. Historical timings from the old
performance branch are not current-main results; no causal diagnosis of their
difference is claimed here. Raw rows are in [timings.csv](results/timings.csv).

## Physical model and falsifying checks

The retained [case](inputs/case.json) and [parameters](inputs/parameters.json)
define the adopted H1/dodecane apparent HBTA/TOPO Li/Na extraction model at
298.15 K and 101325 Pa, with explicitly declared aqueous and organic supports.
The reference point uses organic/aqueous feed-volume ratio 1.0. Independent
directions change organic inventory, LiCl inventory, and NaCl inventory; outputs
are organic Li-carrier moles, organic Na-carrier moles, and aqueous hydrogen-ion
moles. The two reactions couple metal loading, carrier availability, and acidity
within the same constrained equilibrium calculation.

The apparent reaction constants and molecular pseudo-components are calibrated
inputs, not independent physical validation. At feed-volume ratio 1.5, the
calibration check returns distribution ratios 33.7000000034 (Li) and
0.0160000000151 (Na), within the unchanged relative tolerance of 1e-7.
The [inventory sweep](results/inventory-sweep.csv) and
[reaction control](results/reaction-control.csv) retain the other states.
Freezing chemistry is a different constraint set: its original reaction
affinities need not vanish and are not treated as reactive-equilibrium acceptance.

All 67 central, finite-difference, and timing-state rows in
[physical-checks.csv](results/physical-checks.csv) passed the existing screens:
conserved-moiety error at most 1.42e-14 mol, charge error 8.67e-15 mol, zero
off-support amounts, reaction log-affinity error 1.09e-13, relative pressure error
5.65e-11, and KKT residual 1.82e-12. Each had full state rank and positive reduced
curvature. The central independently resolved density-root relative error was
5.55e-16. The producer checks other sweep/control rows separately, including
independent liquid roots; no criterion was relaxed.

The [18 derivative comparisons](results/derivatives.csv) cover both central
finite-difference steps, 0.001 and 0.0005 (O/A units or mol as recorded).
At the finer step, the maximum relative difference from exact A1 was
3.515e-6, below the existing 5e-6 criterion. Native tests separately compare
batched and independent calls, check a single factorization, and retain
direction-local reference/thermal refusals and the existing mixed A1–A3 behavior.

## Reproduction and qualification

Run [scripts/run.py](scripts/run.py) using the repository's non-editable installed
wheel, then [scripts/render.py](scripts/render.py) to render the retained timings.
The figure script imports no Engine code and does not rerun the model. Numerical
execution used CPU 0, nice 19, one thread per numerical library, a serialized
heavy-work lock, and a 700000 KiB virtual-memory ceiling. The producer's peak RSS
was 40440 KiB. The combined fast checks, native equilibrium/branch checks, study,
and figure render took 68.35 s and peaked at 279628 KiB RSS.

The tested source was `80f23237e2fde391e83e5d88c951c36e655f08d2`, incorporating
main's `f2d1e01f` and its fixed-source-pressure reference reuse. Engine source was
clean when measured; unrelated checkout files were not included. The complete
[provenance](results/provenance.json) records input hashes, environment, timings,
and an empty failure list. Installed-wheel SHA-256:
`78a2695fe0cc7c286f61c404ac0178050ad69335fc1a50598a4c140b2a4e7075`.
Build fingerprint:
`1c716148c02874703bfa2802669516b9085f37a8fa0027ad09907c02fd400acc`.

`bash tools/check-all.sh` passed (62 Python tests, six native suites, lint,
typing, layout, architecture, and code budgets). The separately requested native
equilibrium suite and E4-P branch-admission checks also passed. These checks
qualify this implementation boundary; they do not establish global phase
stability, phase discovery, general electrolyte accuracy, or application-level
optimization performance. The [trace profile](results/profile.csv) is retained
for interpretation, not used as an untraced performance estimate.

Independent ordinary source and delivered-evidence review (Godel, 2026-09-22)
supports this integration with the stated scientific limits and no material
blocker. The native equilibrium record contains 6173 true comparisons and
973 observations, with no false comparisons, errors, or failures. Same-source
HTML and all 27 local links/anchors were checked; the retained figure was
visually inspected. Review does not extend the numerical claim beyond this case.
